key_insight: The paper makes operator learning self-explainable by rewriting predictions as localized integral contributions, so the model reveals which input regions drive each output pattern.
engineering_relevance: This adds physically interpretable trust to surrogate models for fluid mechanics, helping engineers diagnose blood-flow and aerodynamics predictions rather than relying on opaque black boxes.
method: Reformulate operator learning as generalized functional linear models with integral equations.
Split the input domain into subdomains and compute localized integrals to attribute regional influence.
Use the additive decomposition to explain both function-to-scalar and function-to-function mappings.
evidence_signal: The framework was tested on blood flow and unsteady aerodynamics tasks, and it highlighted regions with strong feature gradients while showing qualitative agreement with standard post-hoc explainers.
watch_item: Interpretability depends on how the domain is partitioned, so subdomain choice and resolution may affect the fidelity and practicality of the explanations.
paper_title: Self-explainable Operator Learning for Discovering Spatial Patterns in Functional Data
